bureau: Mauritius Credit Information Bureau (Bank of Mauritius)
note: The Bank of Mauritius's MCIB terms and conditions, section 10.1: data on arrears is purged three years from the date the credit is regularised (bom.mu's certificate chain lacks its Sectigo intermediate, completed from the CA's own AIA copy). No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Bank of Mauritius, The Mauritius Credit Information Bureau: Terms and Conditions
sources.said: For negative information, data pertaining thereto and in the case of credit facilities with arrears, data pertaining to the arrears shall be purged from the system, three (3) years as from the date the negative credit has been regularised.
